correctness.rationale: The completely positive trace-decreasing semigroup is positivity improving through connected two-way jump paths, giving one Perron stationary eigenmatrix. Leaf-permutation symmetry reduces the stationary state to h,s,d and hub–bright coherence z; direct Lindblad substitution yields the stated equations. With t=1/m the rescaled system at t=0 has solution D0=1,H0=1-eta,lambda0=-gamma eta(2-eta),S0=[1+a(1-eta)]/(1+a), a=4J²/(gamma²(1-eta)²). The implicit Jacobian is nonsingular and yields O(1/m) errors. Concurrence of the one-excitation two-site reductions equals twice coherence magnitude, giving the two m^-2 constants and their ratio. Independent full superoperator-vs-5-dimensional reduced calculations matched m=2,3,5; three m=3000 asymptotic checks passed. This numerical agreement does not prove large-m asymptotics.
